changes.observation: Dense aggregate texture has been removed; broad colored planes are much smoother.
Two small whole-sentence lines become four larger meaning-based lines. Word boundaries and punctuation remain the same.
One-line title and large diagonal light/pavement/footprint arrangement remain recognizably stable.
Neutral cream opening is replaced by yellow light; text contrast remains dark-on-light.
Flattened blue window strip now visibly joins upper title edges.

residuals.location: Wide yellow area and lower/right blue pavement
residuals.observation: Stone granules are gone but subtle broad shading remains, so the finish is not fully uniform flat color.

residuals.location: Upper left, top portions of the first title word
residuals.observation: A narrow blue window-shadow strip crosses the upper part of the dark blue title and joins some glyph edges to the surrounding graphic. Wording remains readable; edge separation is reduced.

earlier_advantages_preserved: Main title hierarchy and shared left reading start.
Recognizable two-step worn shoe traces with lower print cropped.
